# PLOS LaTeX files

`plos_latex_template.tex` and `plos2025.bst` were obtained unchanged except for
normalizing line endings from PLOS ONE's official template download on
16 November 2026:

https://journals.plos.org/plosone/s/file?id=1457%2FPLOS_latex_template.zip

The template identifies itself as version 3.8, April 2026. These third-party
journal formatting files are not relabeled as MIT or as the study's CC BY
material. Preserve the original comments and notices when redistributing them.
The bibliography style preserves its LaTeX Project Public License notice
(version 1.3 or later). The download has no separate license file for the
template; consult PLOS for reuse beyond its intended preparation purpose.
